WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

What our customers say
Saltblock catered our summer party in Tampa this month and they did an exceptional job! From start to finish - the quality of both the food and the service were extraordinary. Parker Skornschek made our event easy and fun. He is an excellent communicator and gave us the party we envisioned. We live in San Francisco and Parker made planning our party "long distance" a delightful experience. His preparation was awesome - he visited the house / location ahead of our arrival and made suggestions that we followed for the food layout. We asked for “California cuisine” and he created a menu that exceeded our expectations. Every dish was tasty, lovely and plentiful. Our guests complimented the delicious food, beautiful display and professional service. Staff Chef Grace, Lead assistant Akima, Kelly and Yoandra arrived early, prepped, prepared, arranged and served in the most subtle seamless way. Clean-up was fast and impeccable. We HIGHLY recommend Parker, his team and SaltBlock Hospitality, and we hope to work with them again.
Donna Epstein
23 days ago
SaltBlock Hospitality exceeded our expectations on our wedding day. From the very beginning, their team was professional, responsive, and genuinely invested in creating an incredible dining experience for our guests. We loved the tasting experience and it was very special to meet the chef and team. They were so patient with our back and forth as we dialed in the contract and accommodated all of the tricky diet restrictions in our party. They executed our plated dinner service beautifully, ensuring each course was delivered smoothly and efficiently while maintaining a warm and hospitable presence throughout the evening. The food was excellent, presentation was beautiful, and our guests consistently commented on how attentive and professional the service staff were. In addition to dinner service, the team also assisted with our wedding cake, making sure it was presented and served seamlessly. Having a vendor we could trust with so many important details allowed us to relax and enjoy our celebration knowing everything was in capable hands. We are incredibly grateful to the entire SaltBlock Hospitality team for helping make our wedding day so memorable. We highly recommend them to any couple looking for exceptional service, professionalism, and genuine hospitality.
Frank & Brianna
1 month ago
